# schema/token_cache — valid spec produces no diagnostics and exits 0
# No testserver needed; validate performs static analysis only.

exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
! stdout .

-- spec.yml --
# auth.oauth2.client_credentials with cache + cursor_token pagination.
ir_version: "1"

state:
  fields:
    url:
      type: url
      default: "http://localhost:9999"
    initial_interval:
      type: duration
      default: "720h"
    page_size:
      type: int
      default: 5
    token_url:
      type: url
      default: "http://localhost:9999/oauth2/token"
    client_id:
      type: string
      default: "test-client"
    client_secret:
      type: secret
      default: "test-secret"

defaults:
  base_url: {ref: state.url}

# OAuth2 client_credentials with token caching + cursor_token pagination.
# The framework caches the access_token in state.token (auto-registered).
# On iterations 2+, the cached token is reused unless within expiry_buffer
# of expiring, in which case a fresh token fetch is triggered automatically.
auth:
  oauth2:
    client_credentials:
      token_url: {ref: state.token_url}
      client_id: {ref: state.client_id}
      client_secret: {ref: state.client_secret}
      cache:
        store_in: token
        expiry_field: expires_in
        expiry_buffer: 60s

requests:
  - method: GET
    path: /api/v1/findings
    query:
      cursor: {from_pagination: token}
      limit: {format: string, value: {ref: state.page_size}}

response:
  decode: json
  events_at: findings

pagination:
  cursor_token:
    token_at: next_cursor
    send_as: query.cursor

progress:
  latest_event_timestamp:
    event_time:
      path: created_at

error:
  mode: standard
